statement: Let n be the number of nodes in head. Whenever reverse_list head returns a result r, if xs is the sequence of node values of head read from head to tail and ys is the sequence of node values of r read from head to tail, then len(ys) = n and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, ys[i] = xs[n - 1 - i].
preconditions: The input list head has at most 5000 nodes, and every node value in head lies in the inclusive range [-5000, 5000].

statement: For every head satisfying the preconditions, reverse_list head returns a result r; it does not fail.
preconditions: The input list head has at most 5000 nodes, and every node value in head lies in the inclusive range [-5000, 5000].
